text:
Hypothesis: The bug is in `tenacity/__init__.py`, `RetryError.reraise()`. When the final attempt raises `TryAgain`, the method only checks `TryAgain.__cause__`. A bare `raise TryAgain` inside an `except` block sets `TryAgain.__context__` to the original exception instead, so no underlying exception is found and the sentinel is re-raised.

I intend to update `RetryError.reraise()` to use the explicit cause when present, otherwise fall back to `__context__`, while retaining the existing behavior of re-raising `TryAgain` when neither is available.
